abstract: We analyze the re-placement mechanism implemented in Türkiye for reassigning doctors to residency programs after scoring errors were realized. By law, initial placements based on faulty scores are acquired rights, prohibiting re-placement to less favorable programs. This setup requires balancing fairness for doctors with improved rankings, preserving acquired rights, and adhering to program capacities. Our analysis focuses on the two-step serial dictatorship mechanism implemented by the Center for Assessment, Selection, and Placement (CASP) to address this problem. We show that the CASP mechanism violates fairness, such that higher-scoring doctors may justifiably envy the assignments of lower-scoring peers. Yet, when doctors adopt a weakly dominant strategy and truncate preferences below their initial placements, a more lenient notion of q-fairness is satisfied. Additionally, we show how manipulation incentives under the CASP mechanism lead to excessive deviations from target capacities. We propose the Acquired Rights Adjusted Serial Dictatorship (AR-SD) mechanism to prevent strategic manipulation and minimize deviations. Furthermore, we describe simple modifications to the CASP mechanism that render it equivalent to AR-SD. Finally, simulations using total deviations as a metric show that AR-SD consistently achieves fewer deviations than the CASP mechanism.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了土耳其在发现评分错误后，为重新分配医生至住院医师项目而实施的重新安置机制。根据法律，基于错误评分的初次安置被视为既得权利，禁止将医生重新安置至较不理想的方案。这一设定要求在改善排名的医生公平性、维护既得权利以及遵守项目容量之间寻求平衡。我们的分析聚焦于评估、选拔与安置中心（CASP）为解决此问题而实施的两步序列独裁机制。我们证明，CASP机制违反了公平性，使得得分较高的医生可能合理地对得分较低同行的分配产生嫉妒。然而，当医生采取弱主导策略并将其偏好截断至初次安置之下时，一种更为宽松的q-公平性概念得以满足。此外，我们展示了CASP机制下的操纵激励如何导致对目标容量的过度偏离。我们提出了既得权利调整序列独裁（AR-SD）机制，以防止策略性操纵并最小化偏离。进一步，我们描述了将CASP机制简单修改后使其等同于AR-SD的方法。最后，使用总偏离度作为指标的模拟显示，AR-SD始终比CASP机制实现更少的偏离。
title: Preserving acquired rights in the re-placement of medical residents in Türkiye
title_zh: 土耳其住院医师重新安置中保留既得权利

abstract: This paper examines the relationship between crises and the intrahousehold allocation of resources. Using data from Mexico, I estimate a structural collective model to identify the distribution of household resources among its members. Then, I construct a proxy for women’s bargaining power on the basis of their control of resources and document how it evolves over periods of economic stability and contraction. The results indicate that during the COVID-19 crisis, women’s control over household resources declined by approximately 4–5 percentage points compared with non-recession periods and by 6–8 percentage points relative to the financial crisis, with a more pronounced effect for households with children. I further analyze how this resource reallocation affects individual poverty. The findings highlight the heterogeneous behavior of intrahousehold inequality over the business cycle. They also suggest that the hypothesis that the financial crisis was a “man-cession” and the COVID-19 crisis was a “she-cession” holds in terms of intrahousehold resource allocation.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了危机与家庭内部资源配置之间的关系。利用墨西哥的数据，我估计了一个结构性集体模型，以识别家庭成员间资源的分配情况。随后，我基于女性对资源的控制构建了一个衡量其议价能力的代理指标，并记录了该指标在经济稳定期与收缩期的演变过程。结果表明，在COVID-19危机期间，女性对家庭资源的控制相比非衰退时期下降了约4至5个百分点，相比金融危机时期下降了6至8个百分点，且对有子女的家庭影响更为显著。我进一步分析了这种资源重新配置对个体贫困的影响。研究结果凸显了家庭内部不平等在经济周期中的异质性表现，同时也表明，关于金融危机为“男性衰退”和COVID-19危机为“女性衰退”的假设，在家庭内部资源配置方面得到了证实。
title: COVID-19, Crises, and Women’s Control of Resources: Evidence from Mexico
title_zh: COVID-19、危机与女性资源控制：来自墨西哥的证据

abstract: Modern empirical analysis often relies on high-dimensional panel datasets with non-negligible cross-sectional and time-series correlations. Factor models are natural for capturing such dependencies. A tensor factor model describes the d -dimensional panel as a sum of a reduced rank component and an idiosyncratic noise, generalizing traditional factor models for two-dimensional panels. We consider a tensor factor model corresponding to the notion of a reduced multilinear rank of a tensor. We show that for a strong factor model, a simple tensor principal component analysis algorithm is optimal for estimating factors and loadings. When the factors are weak, the convergence rate of simple TPCA can be improved with alternating least-squares iterations. We also provide inferential results for factors and loadings and propose the first test to select the number of factors. The new tools are applied to the problem of imputing missing values in a multidimensional panel of firm characteristics.
title: Tensor PCA for factor models
title_zh: 因子模型的张量主成分分析
